resources.name: The League of Moveable Type
resources.description: One of the first free, open-source web font foundries, small library but well-crafted.

resources.name: Collletttivo
resources.description: Open-source, collectively designed contemporary Italian typefaces.

resources.name: Google Fonts
resources.description: Free, open-source web font library, huge but hit-or-miss on quality, also hosts Material Symbols, a solid icon set.

resources.name: FontShare
resources.description: Curated free fonts from Indian Type Foundry, generally more polished than most free libraries.

resources.name: Velvetyne
resources.description: French, community-run foundry, leans experimental and multilingual.

resources.name: Bye Bye Binary
resources.description: French collective distributing inclusive, non-binary and post-binary typefaces.

resources.name: Open Source Publishing
resources.description: Brussels-based collective building libre fonts and tools, DIY and workshop-driven.

resources.name: Wordmark
resources.description: Types your text out across every font installed on your system at once, for quick comparison.

resources.name: Mockups Design
resources.description: Layered PSD mockups organized by category, packaging, business cards, apparel, outdoor signage, more realistic than generic template packs.

resources.name: Poly Haven
resources.description: Mainly for 3D work but they offer a wide range of textures that can be used for other purposes.

resources.name: Ambient CG
resources.description: PBR materials, more focused purely on textures than Poly Haven.

resources.name: Texture Labs
resources.description: A wide range of high-quality textures, leaning grunge, paper, and print-decay, photographic overlays rather than the PBR materials Poly Haven and Ambient CG use.

resources.name: Public Domain Image Archive
resources.description: Hand-picked collection of out-of-copyright works.

resources.name: NYPL Digital Collections
resources.description: Collection of items digitized from The New York Public Library's collections.

resources.name: Transparent Textures
resources.description: Collection of textures with css presets.

resources.name: Krita
resources.description: Free, open-source raster editor, focused on digital painting and illustration.

resources.name: Photopea
resources.pricing_note: Free with ads, paid to remove them
resources.description: Photoshop alternative, opens PSD and other native formats.

resources.name: RawTherapee
resources.description: Free, open-source RAW photo processor.

resources.name: GIMP
resources.description: Free, open-source raster editor, similar to Photoshop.

resources.name: Aseprite
resources.pricing_note: Buy a key, or build the source yourself for free
resources.description: Pixel-art editor. Buy a one-time key to support the developer, or build the source yourself for free.

resources.name: LibreSprite
resources.description: Fork of Aseprite. Less advanced but excellent if you're looking for a more straightforward alternative.

resources.name: Snapseed
resources.description: Google's photo editing app, known for its powerful yet easy-to-use tools.

resources.name: Affinity
resources.description: Professional creative suite for design and photo editing, free alternative to Illustrator & InDesign, with Canva AI integration.

resources.name: theSVG
resources.description: One of the larger free brand-logo SVG libraries, multiple variants per brand (color, mono, light, dark, wordmark), no attribution required.

resources.name: Vecteezy
resources.description: Stock images and vector assets/templates, free tier is limited but worth digging through.

resources.name: Flaticon
resources.description: Mostly paid vector content, but they have a free high-quality collection of icons, including monochrome brand icons.

resources.name: FontForge
resources.description: Free, open-source editor for building or modifying typefaces at the point/curve level.

resources.name: Graphite
resources.description: Early-stage open-source vector editor, node-based and non-destructive.

resources.name: VectorPea
resources.description: Illustrator alternative from the same developer as Photopea, opens AI, SVG and PDF files.

resources.name: Inkscape
resources.description: Free, open-source vector editor, similar to Illustrator.

resources.name: Calligra Karbon
resources.description: Free, open-source vector editor, similar to Inkscape.

resources.name: Canva
resources.pricing_note: Free, with paid options; requires an account
resources.description: Simple and fast design tool with a vast library of templates and assets.

resources.name: Adobe Color
resources.pricing_note: Needs an Adobe account to save
resources.description: Palette generator and library with direct Creative Cloud export, plus a large community-submitted library.

resources.name: Coolors
resources.description: Fast color palette generator, with a large library of user-submitted palettes.

resources.name: Color Hunt
resources.description: Curated collection of color palettes, with a focus on modern and trendy color combinations.

resources.name: Colormind
resources.description: AI palette generator trained on photography, film, and art datasets, lock in a color and it fills in the rest, or pull a palette straight from an uploaded image.

resources.name: Color Hex
resources.description: All-in-one color tool, shades, tints, RGB/CMYK percentages, and ready-to-copy CSS for backgrounds, text, borders, and shadows.

resources.name: Huemint
resources.description: Color palette generator with templates to visualize color combinations in real use-cases.

resources.name: AnyGradient
resources.description: Universal gradient generator with OKLCH & Display-P3 support.

resources.name: FeralUI Gradient Builder
resources.description: Palette preview software, with gradient studies across shape, backdrop, and colour.

resources.name: are.na
resources.description: Algorithm-free platform for curating and sharing ideas.

resources.name: Cosmos
resources.description: Visual moodboarding tool, built around a searchable image grid with a color-based search tool.

resources.name: Behance
resources.description: Adobe's portfolio platform, full project case studies across every design discipline.

resources.name: Pinterest
resources.description: The default moodboard tool, deep library but mid algorithm and ad-driven.

resources.name: Branding Styleguides
resources.description: Archive of real brand guideline documents pulled from actual companies.

resources.name: Fonts in Use
resources.description: Archive of typefaces spotted in real design work, searchable by font or by industry.

resources.name: Savee
resources.description: Minimalist, ad-free image curation, another alternative to Pinterest, similar to Cosmos.

resources.name: PureRef
resources.pricing_note: Pay what you want, free for personal use
resources.description: Lightweight reference board, keeps pinned images on top of other windows.

resources.name: Anytype
resources.description: Free knowledge management tool.

resources.name: Logseq
resources.description: Another free, open-source knowledge management tool, self-hostable.

resources.name: Kdenlive
resources.description: Video editor, similar to Adobe Premiere.

resources.name: Blender
resources.description: 3D software at its core, but its node-based compositor and Grease Pencil tools make it a genuinely usable free alternative to After Effects for motion graphics.

resources.name: DaVinci Resolve
resources.description: Closed-source video editor, similar to Adobe Premiere.

resources.name: Glaxnimate
resources.description: Vector animation tool built around the Lottie format, closer to a free After Effects plus Bodymovin workflow than to Adobe Animate.

resources.name: Freesound
resources.description: Collaborative collection of sound effects and field recordings, searchable by license type.

resources.name: Free SFX
resources.description: Free sound effects for all situations, searchable by category.

resources.name: Audacity
resources.description: Audio recording & editing software.

resources.name: 8 Bit Composer
resources.description: 8-bit chiptune music tracker.

resources.name: LMMS
resources.description: Digital audio workstation.

resources.name: ChipTone
resources.description: Procedural retro sound effect generator.

resources.name: Twinmotion
resources.pricing_note: Free for revenue under $1M/year; requires an Epic account
resources.description: Real-time 3D visualization software powered by Unreal Engine.

resources.name: Blockbench
resources.description: 3D modeler for creating voxel art, suitable for Minecraft models.

resources.name: Materialize
resources.description: Turns a single image into normal, height, and AO maps for PBR materials.

resources.name: Kenney
resources.description: Over 30,000 game assets (sprites, UI, audio, fonts), about as close to a default starting point as free game asset libraries get.

resources.name: OpenGameArt
resources.description: Community-submitted game art and audio, check each asset's license individually since it isn't uniformly CC0 like Kenney.

resources.name: LÖVE
resources.description: Lightweight 2D game framework built around Lua, code-only with no built-in editor, popular for jams and small prototypes thanks to its minimal learning curve.

resources.name: Phaser
resources.description: Free 2D framework for browser games, worth a look if you want a link-and-play web build instead of a native install.

resources.name: Godot
resources.description: Free general-purpose engine for 2D and 3D, node-based scene system, scriptable in GDScript or C#, closest free alternative to Unity.

resources.name: Unity
resources.pricing_note: Free under $200K/yr revenue or funding, paid tiers above
resources.description: Closed-source industry-standard engine for 2D and 3D, C# scripting, huge asset store and community.

resources.name: GameMaker
resources.pricing_note: Free for non-commercial use, $99.99 one-time for commercial
resources.description: 2D-focused engine with drag-and-drop plus its own GML scripting language, behind Undertale, Hotline Miami, and Hyper Light Drifter.

resources.name: GDevelop
resources.description: No-code, event-based 2D engine, a gentler starting point than Godot or GameMaker if you'd rather not write code yet.

resources.name: Construct 3
resources.description: Browser-based no-code 2D engine, drag-and-drop event sheets, free tier caps events and layers, full access needs a subscription.

resources.name: Defold
resources.description: Lightweight 2D-focused engine built by King, Lua scripting, tiny builds, strong for mobile.

resources.name: Tiled
resources.description: Engine-agnostic tile map editor, worth having regardless of which engine you land on for room-based or tile-based level design.

resources.name: LDtk
resources.description: Entity-driven level editor from the Dead Cells designer, complements Tiled rather than replacing it, better suited to placed objects than large tile grids.

resources.name: WPS Office
resources.description: AI-powered office suite, available on all platforms.

resources.name: LibreOffice
resources.description: Office suite.

resources.name: Google Drive
resources.description: Slides, Docs, and Sheets are nice alternatives to Microsoft Office.

resources.name: Zen Browser
resources.description: Based on Firefox, workflow might seem a bit odd at first but once you get the hang of it, you don't go back from it (DRM support is broken on windows).

resources.name: Firefox
resources.description: Privacy and freedom first web browser, faster and lighter engine than chromium browsers.

resources.name: Brave Browser
resources.description: Privacy-focused web browser, blocks ads and trackers by default.

resources.name: uBlock Origin
resources.description: Content blocker, efficient and highly configurable. Chrome only gets uBlock Origin Lite since Google pulled the full version after the Manifest V3 switch, noticeably weaker filtering than the Firefox version.

resources.name: Privacy Badger
resources.description: From the EFF, learns to block invisible trackers automatically based on their behavior rather than relying on a manual filter list.

resources.name: Decentraleyes
resources.description: Serves common libraries (jQuery, etc.) locally instead of fetching them from third-party CDNs, blocking a common tracking vector without breaking sites that depend on those CDNs.

resources.name: Don't track me Google
resources.description: Strips Google's click-tracking redirect wrapper from Search and Maps links, so clicking or copying a result gives you the real URL directly.
